-- Variables & Services
local targetName = ""
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Helper Function to find target player accurately (Supports DisplayName and Username)
local function getTarget()
   if targetName == "" then return nil end
   local lowerTarget = targetName:lower()
   for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
       if player ~= LocalPlayer then
           local nameMatch = player.Name:lower():find(lowerTarget)
           local dispMatch = player.DisplayName:lower():find(lowerTarget)
           if nameMatch or dispMatch then
               if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                   return player.Character
               end
           end
       end
   end
   return nil
end

         LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = targetChar.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
      end
   end,
})

-- Smooth Bang (Fixed & Optimized)
local bangConn
TrollTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "BANG",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      _G.BangActive = Value
      if _G.BangActive then
         bangConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            local targetChar = getTarget()
            if targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
               local targetHRP = targetChar.HumanoidRootPart
               local offset = math.sin(tick() * 20) * 1.2
               LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = targetHRP.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 1.2 + offset)
               if workspace.CurrentCamera then
                  workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = CFrame.new(workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position, targetHRP.Position)
               end
            end
         end)
      else
         if bangConn then bangConn:Disconnect() end
      end
   end,
})

-- Smooth Mouth Bang (Fixed & Optimized)
local mouthBangConn
TrollTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "MOUTH BANG",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      _G.MouthBangActive = Value
      if _G.MouthBangActive then
         mouthBangConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

            if targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChild("Head") and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
               local targetHead = targetChar.Head
               local offset = math.sin(tick() * 20) * 0.8
               LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = targetHead.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.6, 0.8 + offset) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0)
               if workspace.CurrentCamera then
                  workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = CFrame.new(workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position, targetHead.Position)
               end
            end
         end)
      else
         if mouthBangConn then mouthBangConn:Disconnect() end
      end
   end,
})

-- Headsit (Fixed & Optimized)

   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)

         headSitConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            local targetChar = getTarget()

               LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = targetChar.Head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1, 0)
               if workspace.CurrentCamera then
                  workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = CFrame.new(workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position, targetChar.Head.Position)
               end
               if LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                  LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.PlatformStand = true
               end
            end
         end)
      else
         if headSitConn then headSitConn:Disconnect() end
         if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
            LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.PlatformStand = false
         end
      end
   end,
})
